Mission Local reported that a paid lawn-rental pilot at Dolores Park drew controversy, and that Supervisor Scott Wiener reached a deal with Recreation and Parks to end lawn reservations. The new policy limited reservations to picnic tables; the department confirmed lawn reservations would be suspended. The story also noted that permit fees help cover cleanup costs.
